name: Page tools
author: T-Rustable
description: Rotates, deletes, moves, and inserts pages.

actions.title: Rotate left
actions.description: Rotates the selected pages by 90 degrees counterclockwise.

actions.title: Rotate right
actions.description: Rotates the selected pages by 90 degrees clockwise.

actions.title: Move pages up
actions.description: Moves the selected pages one position toward the start.

actions.title: Move pages down
actions.description: Moves the selected pages one position toward the end.

actions.title: Insert blank page
actions.description: Inserts a blank page after the active page, with the same size.
